verdict.rationale: Moving data in and out is a fair question for a GPU rental platform, but the evidence shows no S3-compatible endpoint, no cloud-storage sync, and no documented upload/download or transfer tooling (e.g. a CLI copy command). Persistent Volumes mounted at /mnt and 6-hourly local-volume backups are storage features, not ways to transfer data in or out, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling
